verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments SaaS that handles customer and transaction data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is used for AI training. The axis applies. The evidence pack covers only payment APIs, SDKs, webhooks and checkout features, with no mention of an AI-training opt-out or a data-use policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
